narrative.synopsis: Deucalion and Pyrrha survive Zeus’ flood not as conquerors but as pious remnants. Their obedience to Themis’ riddle turns stones of Earth into the ancestors of renewed humanity.
narrative.openingSituation: A corrupt age faces destruction by flood.
narrative.centralConflict: The survivors must understand an oracle without violating reverence for their actual mothers.
narrative.resolution: They interpret the riddle as stones of Gaia and cast them behind themselves.
narrative.outcome: Humanity begins again from earth’s bones.
